hard_gate_rule: every hard gate must hold in each architecture/seed/executor; any violation is FAIL uncompensated by latency, coverage or score
reported_metrics: PC1-PC15 violation counters, exact zero per architecture/seed/executor
critical false accepts, post-revoke reads, cross-scope reads (zero)
valid/invalid attestation decisions, raw numerator/denominator and Wilson CI
valid query correctness/recall and false-deny rate
post-revoke allow count, cache resurrection and epoch rollback (zero)
query equality, result size, access pattern and timing leakage, measured or NO_DATA separately, never one secure=true
p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput as local PoC measurements, not SLO
counting_rule: zero numerator with zero denominator is NO_DATA, not 0%. Missing/timeout/censored observations stay in the denominator or make the metric inadmissible. Unknown leakage cells never enter any score and become named limitations.
performance_note: latencies are same-host PoC measurements, never production SLOs
